question: Among users who obtained both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and are located in New York, find the one with the highest reputation. For this user, determine whether their most-viewed post (with at least 1000 views) is well-finished or not.

arguments.sql:
WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
      )
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_viewed_post AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_032 AS body
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT user_id FROM qualified_users)
      AND p.XCL_030 >= 1000
    ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN mvp.body IS NOT NULL AND mvp.body != '' THEN 'Well-finished' ELSE 'Not well-finished' END
FROM most_viewed_post mvp

WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
      )
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_viewed_post AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_032 AS body
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT user_id FROM qualified_users)
      AND p.XCL_030 >= 1000
    ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN mvp.body IS NOT NULL AND mvp.body != '' THEN 'Well-finished' ELSE 'Not well-finished' END
FROM most_viewed_post mvp

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
      )
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_viewed_post AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_032 AS body
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT user_id FROM qualified_users)
      AND p.XCL_030 >= 1000
    ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN mvp.body IS NOT NULL AND mvp.body != '' THEN 'Well-finished' ELSE 'Not well-finished' END
FROM most_viewed_post mvp

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b1 ON u.XCL_052 = b1.XCL_002 AND b1.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
    INNER JOIN badges b2 ON u.XCL_052 = b2.XCL_002 AND b2.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
    ORDER BY u.XCL_060 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN p.XCL_038 > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM qualified_users qu
INNER JOIN posts p ON qu.user_id = p.XCL_033
WHERE p.XCL_031 >= 1000
ORDER BY p.XCL_031 DESC
LIMIT 1
